description: Defines configuration properties related to device connections in Hono's device registry, including a default maximum number of devices per tenant and getter/setter methods to access and modify this property.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionsConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration class for device connection-related properties, primarily managing the maximum devices per tenant setting.

methods.name: getMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Returns the current setting for the maximum number of devices per tenant.

methods.name: setMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of devices per tenant; throws IllegalArgumentException if input is less than or equal to zero.
